steps.name: put the level ladder live through the economy flow (test-creator approving; the prize pool seeded with 0.005 SOL)
make a fresh keeper key with newKeeperKey (`gamesfun economy keeper --new-key`) in a temp folder outside the repo, and fund it with 0.01 SOL from test-creator
"Let my keeper decide": one update_game approved by test-creator
the keeper runs (loopback listener, as `gamesfun economy keeper --key` runs it)
test-buyer-1 pays three attempts (0.01 SOL each, 80% into the prize pool) through gf-web3 economy.pay
too early: attempt 3, claimed at once (the spec says no one clears the ladder in under 20 s)
steps.says: Claimed 1 seconds after the attempt was paid; the economy says no one gets there in under 20 seconds. Fix: If it is real, claim again after 19 more seconds; the rule is "proof.after" in the spec.
